profile.headline: Senior Software Development Engineer at AWS
profile.summary:
Versatile software engineer. Some years of experience software development across multiple technologies and platforms.

Continuous improvement. Through years of work, contests and curiosity, I have developed the ability to solve a vast variety of problems. Self learner and looking for challenging problems and opportunities to improve.

Tech enthusiast. Curious about technological advances such as devices, languages, methodologies, hardware. Why and how find new ways to solve problems.

Through my work, I desire to make a difference in the world, directly or indirectly.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Distributed Systems · Event Driven Programming · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Back-End Web Development · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description: Multiple applications including desktop, web and mobile applications. The requirements and technologies are in constant change. Team members work in almost every area, architecture, database design, api development, open source integration.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description: Multiple applications including desktop, web and mobile applications. The requirements and technologies are in constant change. Team members work in almost every area, architecture, database design, api development, open source integration.

positions.title: Director desarrollo software
positions.description:
Design and Development. 
The tools were built to be as flexible as possible with current technologies and compatible with multiple devices. The problems to be solved were very different. Since internal tools for the same equipment to tools that covered specific customer needs.

positions.title: Líder Desarrollo
positions.description:
Leading the team of 3 persons to develop a project for a national bus company.
Obtain Real Time Data and perform analysis to find trip's irregularities, such as over speed, wrong route, etc.

positions.title: Becario
positions.description:
Actualización y mantenimiento de GEGA.
El uso de un algoritmo genético que encuentre variedad de moléculas y encontrar estructuras con niveles de energía bajos.

positions.title: Técnico Académico
positions.description: Participación en varios proyectos desarrollando software. Interfaces para usuario, implementación de modelos estadísticos.
